claims: NASA's Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch no earlier than April 1, 2026, from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis II mission is a 10-day crewed test flight around the Moon.
Artemis II mission has additional launch opportunities between April 1–6, 2026.
Artemis II mission marks the first human journey beyond Earth orbit since 1972.
Launch vehicle for Artemis II mission is Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Spacecraft for Artemis II mission is Orion.
Crew of Artemis II mission is Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The rocket for Artemis II mission was moved to Launch Pad 39B on March 20, 2026, for final preparations.
As of March 24, 2026, viewing tickets at the Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex are sold out.
